_about: 평가 채점기가 모델에 함께 보여 주는 Process GPT Lite 테넌트의 MCP 도구(이름·설명은 Lite server/mcp/connectors/*.js, office-mcp mcp_server.py 에서 옮김, 인자는 요약). ArtCraft·이음오피스 live 도구는 설계 4.2(skill_only_tools)대로 스킬을 읽기 전에는 보이지 않으므로 넣지 않는다.

tools.name: calendar_find_events
tools.description: Find events in the user's Google Calendar between timeMin and timeMax (ISO dates or datetimes), optionally matching text q. Use before creating events to avoid duplicates.

tools.name: calendar_create_event
tools.description: Create a Google Calendar event. start is YYYY-MM-DD for all-day, or an ISO datetime with offset (e.g. 2026-11-10T22:30:00+09:00).

tools.name: calendar_update_event
tools.description: Update fields of an existing calendar event by id.

tools.name: gmail_search
tools.description: Search the user's Gmail with Gmail query syntax (e.g. "from:x newer_than:7d"). Returns sender, subject, date, snippet.

tools.name: gmail_read
tools.description: Read one Gmail message by id (plain text body).

tools.name: gmail_draft
tools.description: Create a Gmail draft (never sends). The user reviews and sends it.

tools.name: drive_search
tools.description: Full-text search in the user's Google Drive.

tools.name: drive_read
tools.description: Read a Drive file as text (Docs → text, Sheets → CSV).

tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: List Slack channels the user can see.

tools.name: slack_read_channel
tools.description: Read recent messages of a channel (id or #name). oldest = unix seconds to only get newer messages.

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel as the user. Confirm with the user before posting to shared channels.

tools.name: github_search_issues
tools.description: Search GitHub issues and pull requests (GitHub search syntax, e.g. "repo:owner/name is:open label:bug").

tools.name: github_list_prs
tools.description: Open pull requests that involve the user (authored, assigned or review requested).

tools.name: github_create_issue
tools.description: Create an issue in a repository (owner/name).

tools.name: notion_search
tools.description: Search Notion pages shared with the integration.

tools.name: notion_read_page
tools.description: Read the text of a Notion page.

tools.name: notion_create_page
tools.description: Create a page under a parent page id with a title and markdown-like content.

tools.name: notion_append_to_page
tools.description: Append markdown-like content to the end of a page.

tools.name: youtube_trending
tools.description: Most popular YouTube videos right now in a region (YouTube Data API chart=mostPopular). region is a 2-letter code (default KR); category is optional, one of these ids: 1 film, 10 music, 17 sports, 20 gaming, 24 entertainment, 25 news …. Returns rank, title, channel, views, likes, published time, url, thumbnail. Without an API key or Google account it returns the closest public approximation (exact_chart: false) together with what is missing and where to connect it — tell the user both; there is nothing more to find in the browser.

tools.name: youtube_search
tools.description: Search YouTube videos. order: viewCount (most viewed first, default), date (newest first), relevance. publishedAfter: hours or days back ("24h", "7d"), a Seoul day (YYYY-MM-DD — for "today" give the date of today) or an ISO time. Uses the YouTube Data API; without a key it reads the public results page (views as shown there, no likes) and says what is missing for the API.

tools.name: youtube_channel_videos
tools.description: List the most recent uploads of a YouTube channel (handle like @name, channel id, or URL). Returns id, title, url, published time, views and likes when known. Works without an API key (channel RSS feed).

tools.name: youtube_video_info
tools.description: Title, upload date, duration, views and description of one video.

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: Transcript text of a video from its captions (manual or auto-generated). lang defaults to ko, falls back to en.

tools.name: browser_task
tools.description: Read a web page in the built-in browser as the user — also pages behind a login: saved logins are filled from the user's vault on the server. Read-only: it never posts, sends, deletes, buys, books or changes settings. Use it only after the connector/API tools and plain public fetches (RSS, public pages) did not work. Takes a few minutes; returns the result, notes and the last page's text.

tools.name: generate_hwpx
tools.description:
HWPX 템플릿을 채워 스토리지 URL로 반환한다.

사용자가 HWPX 작성을 요청하면 즉시 이 도구를 호출한다 (참고문서 선택 플로우 없음).
reference_documents가 비어 있으면 memento 전체 검색으로 관련 자료를 자동 조회한다.
사용자가 이미지 생성/참조 옵션을 선택한 경우 image_generation_enabled, image_reference_enabled에 전달한다.

tools.name: generate_docx
tools.description:
DOCX 템플릿을 LLM으로 채워 스토리지 URL로 반환한다.
템플릿 입력은 둘 중 하나:
- template_file_id: supabase storage path (= knowledge_files.source_ref). bucket=files 에서 직접 다운로드.
- template_url: 외부 http(s) URL (Google Drive 공유 링크 등). file_id 가 없을 때만 사용.
참고문서 선택 플로우 없음 — reference_documents가 비어 있으면 memento 검색으로 자동 조회한다.
